name: zPAM4.09
body:
# zPAM4.09 - EU competitive rules: scr_smoke_type changed to 2 (consistent smoke) - New SA ruleset for the South American region - comp_sa (by brolpzt) - Kick players in team that are not allowed to play in the match - players are warned 2 times and then kicked (by h1z) - Extended match stats: real damage, headshots, entry kills/deaths, aces and clutches (by h1z) ### Summary of rulesets | Setting | EU
`comp` | NA
`comp_na` | SA
`comp_sa` | |---|:---:|:---:|:---:| | **Smoke type** - see [smoke types](https://github.com/eyza-cod2/zpam3#smoke-types)
`scr_smoke_type` | 2 - Consistent | 2 - Consistent | 2 - Consistent | | **Antilag** - player's ping is considered when calculating hits
`g_antilag` | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Shotgun pellet spread** - predefined pattern instead of random spread, see [pellet spread and damage](https://github.com/eyza-cod2/zpam3#pellet-spread-and-pellet-damage)
`g_shotgun_spread_fix` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Shotgun pellet damage** - damage depends only on distance, see [pellet spread and damage](https://github.com/eyza-cod2/zpam3#pellet-spread-and-pellet-damage)
`scr_shotgun_consistent` | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | | **Buffed BAR** - faster reload and fire rate
`scr_bar_buffed` | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | | **Buffed Bren** - faster reload
`scr_bren_buffed` | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | | **British on Breakout TLS** - British instead of Americans
`scr_breakout_british` | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | Same in all regions: neck shots count as headshots (`scr_hitbox_neck_kill 1`), server fps 30 (`sv_fps 30`).
